summary: xo-online set up: online two-player XO web game, 5 tasks (spec, build, tests, review, preview)

actions.name: XO Online
actions.description: Two-player online XO (tic-tac-toe) web game played through a shared link, with names, locked rooms, a lobby of open games, rematch and score. Professional, fully animated UI.
actions.businessRequirements: Players enter names; share a game link; a third visitor sees the game is locked; the lobby lists games waiting for a player; rematch with the same opponent; running score; professional animated UI; Arabic (RTL) + English.
actions.technicalRequirements: Vite + React + TypeScript static site; realtime through a free public MQTT broker over WSS (no accounts, $0), configurable broker URL; hash routes for share links; Vitest + Testing Library; GitHub Actions CI; preview at /agency-projects/xo-online/.
actions.scope: In: the features above. Out: accounts, matchmaking against strangers by skill, chat, spectating, AI opponent, persistent history across devices.

actions.title: One-page spec with user stories
acceptanceCriteria: User stories with Given/When/Then for names, share link, locked room, lobby, rematch, score, animated UI

actions.title: Build the web game (Vite + React + TS)
acceptanceCriteria: Realtime transport at $0 behind an interface
base from BASE_PATH; build:preview script; npm run build:preview passes

actions.title: Automated tests and CI
acceptanceCriteria: A Vitest + Testing Library test per acceptance criterion
.github/workflows/xo-online.yml path-filtered, runs npm ci, npm test, npm run build:preview

actions.title: Independent quality review
acceptanceCriteria: Claims vs evidence per acceptance criterion

actions.title: Preview link for the CEO
actions.expectedOutput: https://mohamad-ilyas.github.io/agency-projects/xo-online/ after the CEO runs Publish previews

actions.body: XO Online kicked off as a quick app. Realtime play will use a free public MQTT broker (no accounts, $0) — open question 1 asks the CEO to confirm that. Oliver is writing the spec.
